releases.title: New main menu: Quick Play and My Career
items: The main menu has three big cards: Forbidden Fusion, Dynasty and My Career (coming next: be the player, not the coach).
Brawl, Grids, Gauntlet, Tier Target and Blind Tier List are together under Quick Play, for games you finish in one sitting.

releases.title: Training, a 2-round draft, playoff seeds, snap streaks and second-role perks
items: Dynasty: Train this week. Once a week, a random stat (Power, Aura or Clutch) goes up +1 for 3 random healthy cards.
Dynasty: stars take longer. Above 90, each +1 Power costs 2 skill points.

Dynasty: the draft is 2 rounds. Second-rounders sign for 1.2 a season for 2 seasons, and the cap starts at 168 to make room. In free agency you can sign up to 2 over and cut down to 10 before the season.
Dynasty: Rookie of the Year. The best rookie moves up a dev trait (a Superstar rookie gets +2 Power).
Dynasty: breakout jumps. Young cards under 90 Power who played 75% of the games and had a big year get +3 Power and +5 to their max (one per team, up to 8 a season).
Dynasty: a Playoff Picture from week 6 ("if the season ended today") and a seeds list in the playoffs, in Standings.
Dynasty: the squad chat's third option is now POWER UP: +2 Power next game (it was +3 Chaos).
Dynasty: the free agency slider drags smoothly now, and there are − / + buttons.
Second roles add a small perk: Striker +1.5% damage, Tank 1.5% less damage taken, Speedster dodges 2% of hits, Mystic specials hit 10% harder, Tactician +3% damage in a bad matchup.
Boo snaps now come with real photos. Snap back to start a 🔥 streak; at 3+, every snap back gives a small Aura bonus. Miss one and it resets.
Quick texts and Matchup dating lines are different in Dynasty (games, the season) and Forbidden Fusion (the Tower, floors).
The floating phone button no longer covers buttons at the bottom of the page.

releases.title: Fewer text messages
items: Forbidden Fusion: about half as many texts. At most 2 optional texts a floor, and trash talk, deals and backup offers come less often. Boss setups, rematches, contracts and replies to you still always come through.
Dynasty: under 1 text a week on average, down from about 2. Squad chats, coach texts and trade calls come less often, with at most 2 a week.

releases.title: Real Lenz photos, 4 new songs, movable phone on PC
items: Lenz posts now use 27 real photos: training, food, fight day, after a win, days off, plus the Celestial Grail and the GPT trophy.

Fewer, bigger posts. Dynasty: playoff wins, upsets, win streaks, a title or a GPT award, and now and then a teammate's day. Forbidden Fusion: bosses, a new best floor, every 10th floor, finished contracts and big jobs.
Win the Celestial Grail and your team posts the trophy. Have the GPT and they post theirs.
4 new songs: "Get My Punk On" and "How To Dance" by The Breed, "Miami Vintage" by Sonda, "The Flower" by RA.
On PC you can now drag the phone button anywhere with the mouse. It remembers the spot. Drag it back to the bottom-right corner to put it home.

releases.title: Dynasty playoff bye fix
items: Fixed: a top-6 seed sits out the play-in with a bye, but Dynasty said your run was over and Play out the playoffs simulated your games for you. Now you see your seed and a Sim the play-in button, then you play your quarterfinal yourself.
Play out the playoffs never simulates a game you're still alive for.

releases.title: Mystic elements and save codes
items: Mystics now have elements. Their Hex leaves 🔥 Burn (5% health a turn for 4 turns), ❄️ Freeze (3% a turn for 3 turns, and the frozen card hits 30% softer), ⚡ Shock (4% a turn for 3 turns, draining their special meter) or 🩸 Drain (5% a turn for 3 turns, and the Mystic's side heals 1.5× that).

Every Mystic has the element that fits them (Dabi burns, Aokiji freezes, Enel shocks, Mahito drains), shown on their role chip. In fights you'll see the card catch fire, ice over, crackle or pulse red.
A Forbidden Fusion fighter with Mystic as its main role picks its element in the creator or on the Your Fighter screen.
Hex hits a little harder (1.3×) so Mystics win as often as before overall.

Save codes: in Settings, tap Send or back up saves, then Get a code. Type the 6-letter code on your other device with Enter a save code. Codes need the internet, work once and last 24 hours. The file transfer still works without the internet.

releases.title: Dynasty: the Time Chamber
items: New on the Roster tab: the Time Chamber. Put bench cards inside during the season and they bank skill points every week. Young cards grow faster, and a veteran mentor at the same role helps.
The Chamber trains past a card's limits: its points also raise the card's max, so they always turn into Power. In testing, a Chamber card gained about +4 Power a season against under +1 on the bench.
The catch: cards inside can't play, they pick up fatigue, and there's a 5% chance a week they get hurt. Each card can bank only 3 Chamber points a season at level 1 (4 at level 2, 5 at level 3).
Upgrade the Chamber with cap space: level 2 (2 slots) costs 2, level 3 (3 slots) costs 3.5 more, as dead money this season. The level stays with your team.
The Chamber empties when the season ends.

releases.title: Fusion: bounty requests
items: After you clear a floor, people may text you a job: win the next floor fast, clear it barely scratched, take out a danger floor, survive 5 floors in a row, or beat the next boss.
Take one job at a time. Finish it for extra Bounty (it counts as sponsor money, so it earns talent points too) and followers, and the sender likes you more.
Fail it, or go down with it open, and they think less of you and you lose a few followers. Jobs from your own company pay more, but failing them costs reputation.
Your active job shows on the Tower. Ignore a request and it expires when you start the next floor.
The Forbidden Fusion help is updated for the fighter creator, the new health, contracts and jobs.

releases.title: Dynasty: the waiver wire
items: Front Office has a new Roster moves panel. Release any card on its own to open a roster spot (this season's cap hit stays as dead money), then sign a free agent into the open spot for the rest of the season.
Depth cards (Power 78 and under) sign for the minimum. Better free agents cost 60% of their ask and need cap room. Filter free agents by role.
Released cards go on waivers for a week. AI teams with a weaker card at that spot may claim them, worst record first. You can't sign back a card you cut that season.
Roster moves stay open until after Week 10. You need at least 7 cards, and 6 healthy after a cut. If you ever can't field 5 healthy cards, the league signs a depth card into an open spot.
Roster full? Use Swap to sign a free agent and release someone in one step.

releases.title: Clear your phone notifications
items: Phone notifications now have a Clear all button on the home screen and the lock screen. It clears the notifications and the red badges: texts are marked read, and Chirp mentions, Boo snaps, Matchup and Deals stop counting.
Swipe a notification sideways, or tap its ✕, to dismiss just that one. Tapping a notification opens it and clears it.
Messages has a Mark all read button, and opening Chirp, Boo, Matchup or Deals clears that app's badge. Anything waiting for your reply is still there inside the app.

releases.title: Fusion contracts, fighter creator and Dynasty tampering
items: Forbidden Fusion has a new fighter creator: pick a name and face from any character, then an origin (Street Brawler, Prodigy, Soldier, Rich Kid, Legacy), your style and a personality. Each one changes your stats, followers or contract offers.

Sign with a company before each climb. Three offers come in for 10, 20 or 30 floors. Each pays Bounty per floor cleared and a bonus when you finish. Ask for more if you dare: they might say yes, meet you halfway, or walk.

Lose before the contract is done and the deal falls through: no bonus, and your reputation drops (lower offers next time). You can break a deal with a buyout. No deal? Go in as a free agent at minimum pay until a company texts you.
Fusion health rebalanced so you can actually lose: less health, more healing between floors. Watch for DANGER floors: tougher fights that pay 40% more.

Dynasty: Whispers. In the re-sign step, text up to 3 cards on other teams whose contracts ran out. If it works they skip re-signing and lean your way in free agency. If the texts leak it's a scandal in the news and the preseason magazine: a cap fine, then your draft pick.
AI teams tamper too. One of your expiring cards might text you that another team is in their ear, and their ask goes up 15%. Report it and the league might punish them.

releases.title: Forbidden Fusion: allies
items: Build a bond with a fighter and they'll fight with you. Once you're Close (bond 60+), open their chat and tap "Ask for backup": they jump into your next floor's fight mid-battle with one big hit. At Ride or die (80+) they jump in twice.
Backup isn't free: an ally takes 30% of that floor's Bounty (20% at Ride or die), and only if you win.
Sometimes a fighter you're close with texts first and offers to help.
Rules: no backup on boss floors, nobody helps you against themselves, and an ally rests 3 floors after helping.
Your bonds and contacts now carry over from one climb to the next.

releases.title: Lock screen, your phone your way, and texting anyone
items: The phone has a lock screen: your wallpaper, a big clock and your notifications. Swipe up or tap to unlock, or tap a notification to jump straight to it. You can turn it off in the phone's Settings.

Make the phone yours. In the phone's Settings: separate home and lock screen wallpapers, clock style and color, message previews on or off, rearrange apps, choose your 4 dock apps, hide apps, icon themes (Colorful, Dark, Neon, Gold), phone colors (Graphite, Silver, Gold, T7P purple, White), notification sounds or vibrate, and text size.
Text anyone you've met: tap ✏️ in Messages. Fighters you've faced, your trainer, your Dynasty players and more.

Bonds: every person on your phone has a bond from Stranger to Ride or die. Being friendly, funny or hyping them up raises it; trash talk and insults lower it. Bonds can only rise so much a day. They'll matter soon: Fusion allies are next.
No AI key? Quick texts let you check in, hype someone up, joke around or talk trash, up to 3 a day per person.

Type your own replies: add a free AI key in Settings (Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq or Mistral, plus paid Anthropic or any OpenAI-style service), with step-by-step guides. Characters answer in their own voice, and when a reply is waiting, what you type picks the same outcome a button would. Works in Messages and for @mentions on Chirp. Your key stays in your browser only.
Language filter: on by default. Adults (18+) can turn it off for cursing, darker jokes and flirtier Matchup chats. Nothing sexual, ever.
Lenz photos look like real posts now: scenes, close-up selfies, polaroids, filters, stickers and location tags.

releases.title: Questionnaire delivery
items: Questionnaire answers now go through a private delivery address. Nothing changes for players: fill it out and send it the same way.

releases.title: Playtest questionnaire and time played
items: Playtesters: please play for a week, then fill out the questionnaire! New players see a short welcome that explains it, and the bottom of the main menu counts the days (PLAYTEST · DAY 3 OF 7).

The questionnaire is built into the game: about 5 minutes, with tap-to-rate questions, a rating and one word for each mode, and room to say what got boring or broke. Your answers save as you go, so you can leave and come back.
Send it and it goes straight to the developer. No internet? It's saved on your device and sends itself the next time you're online.

After your playtest week, a small card on the main menu asks for it. It never pops up in the middle of a game. Not now hides it for 3 days, and Don't ask again turns it off. You can fill it out early from Settings or the new Feedback button on the menu.
New in Settings: Time played. Your total, today, the last 7 days, and time in each mode. It only counts while you're actively playing and stops after 2 minutes with no taps or keys.

releases.title: The new foldable phone, social apps, and a working back button
items: The phone is now a foldable. It takes over the whole screen when you open it. On PC, press Unfold to open it up into the big inner screen, and Fold to close it again. It remembers how you left it.
A real home screen: a clock widget with your stats, your apps in a grid, a dock along the bottom, and your notifications.
Change the wallpaper in the phone's Settings: six colors, four arenas, your icon, any character, or upload your own photo. The wallpaper is the same in every mode.
Messages is for texts only now. Anything posted with an @ goes to the new social apps instead.

Chirp (the bird app): fans and haters post about you. When someone @s you it shows up under Mentions, and you can reply right from the post. In Fusion, replies still move your followers. In Dynasty, HYPE THE FANS gives +1 Aura next game and CLAP BACK gives +1 Chaos.
Lenz (the photo app): your big wins get posted with fan comments, and other fighters post too.
Boo (the ghost app): fighters send you snaps. Open one and you get 5 seconds before it's gone. It stays saved in Photos.

Also new: Calendar (your next floors and boss floor in Fusion, your schedule and the trade deadline in Dynasty), Wallet (your Bounty and talent points in Fusion, your cap space and payroll in Dynasty), Photos and News. Dynasty's phone now has every app.
Unfolded, Messages shows your chats and the open conversation side by side.
The phone's back button (or a swipe back) now closes the open pop-up or the phone instead of leaving the app. Inside the phone, back goes up one screen at a time.

releases.title: New main menu and the Talent Tree's second ring
items: New main menu: it fills the screen, with big art cards for Forbidden Fusion, Dynasty and Brawl, the four other modes in one row, and a small icon bar for Records, Fight Lab, Changelog, Ratings, About and Get the app.
A Continue card at the top picks up where you left off, for example "File 2 · KAI · Floor 12" or your Dynasty team's season and week.
On phones the menu keeps its stacked layout and adds the Continue card.
Forbidden Fusion: the Talent Tree has a second ring. Use the rail on the side of the tree screen to switch between Ring 1 and Ring 2.

Ring 2 has four big talents, 3 tiers each at 9 points a tier. Unbreakable (max Power Level and Titan Frame): once a fight you survive a knockout on 1 health, and higher tiers heal you a little. Domain Expansion (max Aura and Signature Move): your special charges faster and the first special of each fight hits up to 2× as hard. Last Stand (max Clutch and Second Wind): up to +20% damage under 25% health. Sponsor Magnet (max Bounty Hunter and Momentum): sponsors call more often and pay up to 50% more.
You can own 2 second-ring talents at most, and you have to max the first before you start the second. The tree tells you why a talent is locked. Respec between climbs to swap.
The talent detail panel has proper spacing now.

releases.title: Play-in playoffs, draft-day trades, saved Tier games
items: Dynasty playoffs now have 10 teams. The 4 division winners are seeds 1–4 and the next 2 best records are 5–6. Seeds 7–10 play a one-game play-in (7 vs 10, 8 vs 9) for the last two spots. Then come quarterfinals, semifinals and the Zenith Clash, all one and done.

OSM now puts out a Play-in issue when the playoffs start (the field, the play-in odds, who just missed, the GPT race) and a Zenith Clash issue right before the final (how both teams got there, their stars, the odds). The season review still follows.
Trade on draft day: trades stay open through the draft, and you can trade the picks still on the board (No. 12 today, and so on).
AI teams trade draft picks now too: a contender will throw in its pick to land a veteran.

Forbidden Fusion: sponsor money goes toward your upgrades, with every 25 Bounty a sponsor pays becoming a talent point. Hard mode earns double talent points. Bosses now come every 10th floor and are worth 5 points.

Tier Target and Blind Tier List save your game as you play. Leave any time and pick up where you left off until you start a new one. Both modes have sound effects now, and on PC the Tier Target pyramid sits next to the dealt card so it fits on the screen.
Brawl: the opening event is now called the AFL Insider Drop. On phones, the draft board uses short team names.
My Records shows Forbidden Fusion by save file: best floor, Hard best, best Bounty, lifetime Bounty and climbs.

releases.title: Trade your picks, bigger contracts, tidy saves
items: Dynasty: trade your draft picks yourself. The trade screen now lists every pick each team owns, with its projected slot. Add picks on top of a card trade, or swap picks for picks. Rebuilds value picks the most and contenders the least.

Higher salaries: mid-level and star players cost more now (Power 80 is about 16 a season, Power 90 about 31). Every team starts the league near the cap, so the hard cap matters for everyone, not just you.
Busts get half the max raise from Star and Superstar upgrades.

Every 2 days, when the game starts, it trims old clutter from your saves: old phone texts, old regular magazine issues, and day-to-day details of long-retired players. A message tells you what it removed. Seasons, records, trophies, stats, history, season reviews and the Hall of Fame are never touched. Settings also has a Clean up saves now button.
Phone-size fixes: the cap panel fits in two rows, phone pop-ups show at the top of the screen instead of covering buttons, and the phone button hides while a sheet or the magazine is open.
Text fixes: Forbidden Fusion now mentions the Talent Tree, and Settings no longer says sound effects are coming soon.

releases.title: Skill points work like Khalil planned
items: Dynasty: every card has a max. Skill points can only raise Power up to that max. Points earned past it stay banked, unspent, until a Star or Superstar upgrade raises the max.
Star upgrades raise the max by up to 10 and Superstar upgrades by 5 or 10, never past 99. Banked points can go in right away.
The roster shows each card's max, how many points are waiting for an upgrade, and a 🔒 when a card is at its max.

releases.title: Talent Tree, skill points and a hard cap
items: Forbidden Fusion: the Gym's training is replaced by a Talent Tree, like The Division 2. Four branches (Power, Aura, Clutch, Hunter) surround your fighter, and every node has tiers. Titan Frame adds health, Signature Move boosts your special, Second Wind heals more after each floor, Bounty Hunter pays more, and Momentum starts each fight with your special meter partly full.

Earn 1 talent point per floor and 3 on a boss floor, and spend them between floors. Anything you buy during a climb stays locked in until the climb ends. Between climbs you can respec for free. Each save file keeps its own tree. Old saves carry over: your build becomes tree tiers, and your Bounty becomes points.
Your Fighter screen still sets your name, face, roles and Chaos.

Dynasty: on your team, growth now gives each card skill points instead of Power. Spend them on Power yourself (1 point = +1, up to 99) on the Roster tab, or turn on Auto upgrade and the game spends them for you.
Star and Superstar upgrades now come with skill points: up to +10 for Star, and +5 or +10 for Superstar. Points past 99 stay on the card, but they can't be used.

The soft cap is gone. There's now a hard salary cap of 160 that grows 5% every off-season. Contracts top out at 35 a season, and a team can carry 3 supermax deals. You can't sign, re-sign, trade or upgrade past the cap. Rookie deals and minimum signings are the exception, so you can always fill out 10.

releases.title: Off-season trades, coaching carousel, preseason OSM
items: The GPP is now the GPT: the Generational Player Trophy.
Trades open again after the season and stay open until draft day. Look for Make a trade at the top of the off-season screens. GMs can call with offers too.

AI coaches now have careers. They retire, and they get fired if they miss expectations, judged the same way you are. New coaches are hired, and sometimes a fired coach gets a second chance. You'll see it under Coaching Changes in the retirements step and in the news.
A preseason OSM issue comes out before Week 1 with the Power 10, division picks, a Zenith Clash pick, GPT favorites, rookies to watch, the off-season's biggest moves, and your outlook.

Draft scouting: a deep scout now shows 💎 (a gem: Star or Superstar, at least 2x growth), nothing (solid: could be any of the three), or 💔 (a bust: always Normal, 1x). Power stays hidden until the draft.
Re-signing: pick the number of seasons and see the total and your cap space after signing right away.
Free agency: filter by career year (Rookie, Year 2, 3, 4, 5+) together with role, like Rookie Speedster, and sort by Power, youngest or most experienced.
On phones, drag the phone button anywhere on the screen. It stays where you leave it.

releases.title: Scrolling fixed, move saves offline, fresher texts
items: Mouse-wheel scrolling works again on PC and in the installed Chrome app. Version 0.18.0 broke it; you shouldn't have needed the scrollbar.

Move saves without the internet: Settings → Send or back up saves. Pick everything or just one save (a Dynasty slot or a Forbidden Fusion file), then send it with AirDrop, Nearby Share or Bluetooth, or save the file and copy it over with a cable.
Restore now asks: Add to this device (keeps everything else) or Replace everything.
Texts don't repeat: a line you've seen or sent won't come back for 2 floors in Fusion or 2 weeks in Dynasty. Every message pool is about twice as big.
Fusion trash talk has a third answer: CLOWN them for +180 followers. It's a coin flip whether they get mad and call you out anyway.
Dynasty upgrades now follow the 1x / 2x / 3x rule: a Star costs double, a Superstar triple, but never more than +6 a season per step.

releases.title: Phones everywhere, five save files and a better League on phones
items: Dynasty on phones: the League screen no longer shrinks to a quarter of the screen. On a phone it now goes Next Game, Games of the Week, League News, Draft Room, Leaders, GPP Race, then the Power 25.
Forbidden Fusion has five save files, like Dynasty. Each one keeps its own fighter, Bounty, Hall of Fame, followers and phone. Your old save is in File 1.

Forbidden Fusion: the people you beat now text you. Gloat for followers, but they come back 3 floors later for a rematch (+3 Power, 1.5× Bounty). Show respect and they send a tip: +4 Aura on your next floor.
The phone closes on mobile: tap the ✕ on the home screen, or tap the bar at the bottom of the home screen.

Sponsors make sense now: each brand's deal fits what it sells (Kiai Energy wants stamina, Shinobi Wear wants you untouched, Callout Cola wants you to answer callouts, Zenith Gloves want a boss knockout), and each one has its own icon.

Dynasty has a phone too. GMs call with trade offers until the deadline, and some offers move draft picks: a contender may give you its pick, or a rebuild may want yours. Text the League Office to shop your pick.
Dynasty team chat: text your squad before each game for +3 Aura, Clutch or Chaos. After a win the other coach texts you: gloat (+2 Chaos) or show respect (+2 Aura). Phone boosts last one game.
Matchup, a dating app, in both modes: like profiles, chat, and ask your matches out. A date is +5 Aura for your next floor in Fusion and +2 Aura for your next game in Dynasty.

releases.title: Forbidden Fusion: your phone
items: Your fighter has a phone. Tap Open phone (or press P; change the key in the phone's Settings) and it slides up over the Tower.
Floor 1 is a normal fight. After that, the phone shapes your climb: someone texts after every floor you clear.
Trash talk: answer HOSTILE and they become your next opponent, a tougher callout fight for 1.5× Bounty. Answer HUMBLE and the climb goes on as normal. Leave them on read and nothing changes.

Bosses reach out before their floor. Some want to test you with their lieutenant first (win and the boss comes in rattled, −5 Power). Others say you're not worth their time; tell them to bring everyone and you fight their crew of 3 for 1.6× Bounty.
Sponsors offer deals (clear 3 floors, win a callout, beat the boss) that pay Bounty. Your trainer checks in when you're hurt: rest to heal now, or push on for full Bounty.
Buzz (fans and haters react to every floor), AGN Wire (headlines from your climb) and Deals apps.
Followers stay with you between climbs: every 2,500 is +1 Aura in the Tower, up to +10.
Dynasty: the OSM spotlight now runs a random quote from you, Aura or Chaos, and your roster gets +5 of it until the next issue.

releases.title: Dynasty: your voice in OSM and the season review
items: OSM Spotlight: you now choose what to tell the magazine. Pick the Aura quote (calm, confident) or the Chaos quote (fiery trash talk) and your whole roster gets +5 of it for the next 3 weeks, until the next issue. The quotes change with how your team is doing: on a heater, winning, even, losing or in a slump.
The Next Game card shows your active quote boost and when it ends.

New: the OSM Season Review, out right after the Zenith Clash. The champions and their stars, every award winner, division and rivalry trophies, your season, and the biggest Aura risers. Aura carries into next season.
Draft board: Watch and Scout right from the list, no need to open each prospect's card. The button turns into Deep scout, then a check mark when they're fully scouted.

releases.title: Draft Room map, auto-updates and fixes
items: Updates now install on their own in the background. When one is ready, a big banner tells you the game will reload, with a countdown. Reload now, or finish what you're doing and it reloads when you're back on the main menu. Your saves are safe.

Dynasty Draft Room: filters and draft news on the left, a map of the AFL continent in the middle, and Prospects / My Board on the right. Tap a region (or its tab) to see its strengths, weaknesses and top prospects, like scouting in Madden. Tap any prospect for their card: watch, scout, deep scout or draft from there.
OSM Spotlight now features you, the head coach (your coach photo, or your player icon), with your team's star listed underneath.
The League screen shows just the Power 25.
Losing a fight now names the winner: "OBSIDIAN DRAGONS WIN" instead of "THEY WIN".
Brawl: a full snake draft board shows every team's picks, round by round, with the pick on the clock highlighted. New Auto-draft the rest button.
Forbidden Fusion: fights start at 2× speed. Roles lock once you save your fighter; changing them costs 10 points for the main role and 5 for the second, paid for good out of your Bounty.

releases.title: Dynasty: a new League screen and the weekly show
items: A new League screen: Power 25 (or your conference) on the left, Games of the Week in the middle, news and the Draft Room below, and your next game, fighter leaders and the GPP race on the right.
Games of the Week are bigger: huge crests on each side, records and streaks, the Dojo pick and the TV slot. Rivalry games show the rivalry trophy, and the GPP race now has its own slide.
Around the League has three tabs: League News, your Conference, and Free Agents (signings, trades, tags and the best upcoming free agents).

Weekly Recap: open a save and you get last week's show: Fighter, KO Artist, Rookie and Bummer of the Week, Game of the Week, the biggest comeback, the blowout, the upset, top-25 clashes, the playoff picture, Power 25 risers and fallers, streaks, draft stock and injuries. Flip back through any week.

Weekly Preview: hit Continue for the week ahead: Game of the Week with win probability, Ace vs Ace matchups, top-25 games with playoff chances (now, with a win, with a loss), upset alert and coin flips, GPP watch, rivalry games with the series record and last meeting, cards facing their old team, and the injury report.
Tick "Don't show again this week" to skip them until next week. Both are also on the Next Game card.
Draft board: tap ☆ Watch on any prospect, then use the My Board tab to see only the prospects you're watching or have scouted.
Fixed: injury news now shows up in Around the League.

releases.title: Dynasty: The End of an Era, plus sound effects
items: Every dynasty now has an ending. When the last original character retires (around season 10), the off-season stops for a send-off to the last legends and the story of your career: record, Grails, trophy shelf, the best players you coached, your Pantheon members, and a final OSM cover with you on it.
The countdown: once 60 legends are left, the news and OSM keep track. The last season is billed as the farewell tour.
The New Era: after the send-off, your save keeps going with made-up characters only, for as long as you want.
Hall of Coaches: every finished dynasty is saved there, with an all-time trophy cabinet. Find it on the Dynasty save screen.

Your legacy carries over: in a new save you can take any job (not just teams that missed the playoffs), your hire makes headlines, and free agents like playing for you. With 2 or more Grails you get one extra season before the hot seat.

Sound effects across the arcade: hits, specials, KOs, round gongs, wins and losses, right and wrong guesses on the grids, button taps, magazine page flips, draft picks and trophy fanfares. Set the volume (or turn them off) in Settings.

releases.title: Made for big screens
items: On big PC monitors the whole arcade now grows with your screen: about a third bigger at 1440p and twice as big at 4K. Text, cards, portraits and buttons all scale together, so nothing looks tiny any more.
Laptops, tablets and phones look exactly the same as before.
If your browser window is short, the game scales a little less so everything still fits.

releases.title: Dynasty fixes and the last trophies
items: Fixed: a card's picture no longer jumps to the top-left corner of the screen when you open its details, and the details aren't squeezed into a thin column any more.
Dynasty now uses more of a wide PC screen instead of a narrow strip in the middle.
New trophy art for the Grandmaster's Cloak, the Awakening Award and the Phoenix Rebirth Trophy. Every AFL trophy now has its own picture.

releases.title: Dynasty: Media and History
items: OSM, the Otaku Sports Magazine, prints an issue every 3 weeks. Flip through it page by page (swipe, tap or use the arrow keys): the cover star, Players of the Month, the Power 10, the GPP race, a spotlight on your team, Rivalry Watch and the league news.
Being in OSM builds Aura: the cover star, your spotlight player and the Dojo's player to watch all gain it.
The Fight Night Dojo picks the 3 biggest games every week and keeps its record. Its picks show on the hub carousel too.
New Media tab: the magazine rack, the Dojo, the full GPP race, every role award race, the breakout and comeback races, and who holds each rivalry trophy.
New Museum: every champion by season, award winners, rivalry trophy records, the Generational Pantheon and the record book.
The Coach tab is now your office: add a coach photo and hang up to 6 pictures from your phone on the office wall. The trophy shelf fills itself with the trophies you win.
New trophy art: sharper role and rivalry trophies with real plaques, and four division trophies: the Sentinel Vanguard, the Northern Cross, the Golden Shore and the Sovereign Shield.
Saves stay small: long-retired cards nobody remembers are cleared out each off-season.

releases.title: Dynasty: The Off-season
items: The AFL now runs season after season. After the Zenith Clash comes the off-season: retirements, awards night, re-signing, upgrades, the draft and free agency.
Real trophies: the Celestial Grail, the GPP glass, the role awards and all six rivalry trophies now show in the news, the Game Plan, recaps and the ceremony.
Retirement is final. Big names at 95+ Power enter the Generational Pantheon, and every retired headshot returns in a draft class under a brand-new name.

New Draft tab: earn 8 scouting points a week. Scouting a prospect (6 points) reveals potential; a second report shows Generational Talent or Bust risk. A hex map shows which worlds the class comes from.
Re-sign your expiring cards for 1 to 4 seasons, or use your one Franchise Tag. Then spend up to 2 development upgrades (Normal → Star → Superstar).
Free agency runs 3 rounds. Every player has an interest meter: money, winning, playing time, teammates from their world, your style and the spotlight.
New Front Office tab: cap and contracts, trades with AI teams that think like rebuilds, contenders or teams a few pieces away (deadline after Week 8), and emergency pickups.
The soft cap bites: going over comes off next season's cap, and two seasons running costs your draft pick.
Get fired after three missed expectations and you pick a new job from the teams that missed the playoffs. The news covers it.

releases.title: Dynasty: The Season
items: Dynasty is here: coach a team in the Anime Fighting League. 32 teams, 4 divisions, a 12-week season, three save slots.
Every new dynasty simulates last season first. Take over any team that missed the playoffs, and the league news reacts to your hire.
A 5-question coach quiz sets your style and perks. Your favorite anime gives its cards on your roster +1 Power.
Every week, open the Game Plan: keys to the game, availability, tale of the tape, and their lineup. Set your order to beat it, then the rival coach gets one final swap.
Cards wear down and can get hurt, so rotate your bench. Young cards grow every 3 weeks; veterans slow down.
Hype comes from winning fights. Aura comes from OSM picks and awards. Both carry over.
Win your division to make the playoffs, then win the semifinal and the Zenith Clash for the Celestial Grail.
Season awards: the Generational Prodigy Award, the five role awards and Coach of the Year. Miss the front office's expectation and your job security drops.
The off-season (retirements, the draft, free agency, trades) is next.

releases.title: Brawl is here
items: New flagship mode, Brawl: snake-draft a five-card squad, one of each role, against seven rival GMs.
Then fight through an 8-team knockout bracket: quarterfinals, semifinals and the final, best of 3 rounds each.
Before each match you see the rival's lineup and set your order to counter it. The rival GM sees yours too and can swap two of its cards, so think one step ahead.
Chemistry: three or more from the same series, or five from one franchise, fight with extra Power.
About half of all Brawls open with a Woj Bomb league event: Rivalry Bracket, Favorable Draw, Stacked Field or Underdog Run.
Game MVPs, a Tournament MVP and your career record (titles, wins, best finish) in My Records.
Dynasty moves to Wave 5 so it can be planned properly first.

releases.title: Forbidden Fusion is here
items: New flagship mode, Forbidden Fusion: forge one fighter in the Gym, then climb the Tower floor by floor.
The Gym: pick any character as your face, choose a main and second role, and spend points on Power, Aura and Clutch. Chaos is free.
The Tower: health carries from floor to floor, every 5th floor is a boss, and past floor 10 the Omega swarms send more cards at once.
Earn Bounty on every floor (double on Hard, half again for underdog wins). Every 100 Bounty adds a Gym point for good. Your ten best climbs go in the Hall of Fame.
The role wheel matters more: a full role advantage is now worth about 10 Power.
Team fights now start at 2× speed. You can still switch to 1× during the fight.

releases.title: Every character has a portrait
items: All 553 characters now have their own portrait, from Adam Warlock to Zeno Zoldyck.
Portraits are saved on your phone the first time you see them, so they work offline after that.

releases.title: New soundtrack
items: New music: 6 hip-hop and lo-fi tracks from Bensound and Uppbeat replace the old playlist. The old songs are cleared off your phone.
About lists every song and artist.
262 characters now have portraits, up to Kid Trunks.

releases.title: Your icon on the loading screen, and a Changelog
items: Once you've picked your icon, it shows on the loading screen instead of the logo.
New Changelog button on the main menu lists every update. About no longer has the update history.
174 characters now have portraits, up to Greed.
About now credits the music.

releases.title: Music and 113 portraits
items: Background music: 7 songs play in a shuffled loop. They start on your first tap and pause when you leave the app.
Settings: Music volume now works (0 turns it off), and there's a Next song button.
113 characters now have portraits, from Adam Warlock to Donner. More are on the way.
Songs are saved on your phone after they play once, so they work offline too.

releases.title: The Combat core and the Fight Lab
items: Fights are here: two cards face off and trade hits, with damage numbers, health bars, special moves and a best-of-3 round score.
The role wheel: Striker beats Mystic and Tactician, Mystic beats Tactician and Tank, Tactician beats Tank and Speedster, Tank beats Speedster and Striker, Speedster beats Striker and Mystic.
Each role has a special move: Finisher, Iron Wall, Blitz, Hex and Counterplay.
Fight Lab on the main menu: pick any characters (1 v 1, 3 v 3 or 5 v 5), watch them fight, or simulate 1,000 fights to see the odds.
The first character portraits are in: Goku and Superman.

releases.title: Wave 2: Tier Target and Blind Tier List
items: Every character now has a Power Level, two roles, and Aura, Clutch and Chaos ratings.
Tier Target: place ten characters on S, A, B and C multiplier squares and land on the target. Hard Mode doubles points and hides the numbers.
Blind Tier List: rank ten characters from a hidden series or trait, then see how your list compares with their Power Levels.
Both new modes are in My Records.

releases.title: Loading screen and update notes
items: The loading screen now takes its time (about 12 seconds) so you can watch every mode load. Tap to skip.
Updates now pop up in the middle of the screen and tell you what's new before you reload.
About now lists every update.

releases.title: Wave 1: Grids and Gauntlet
items: Grids: fill a 3×3 grid on Easy, Medium or Hard. Rarer answers score more.
Gauntlet: 5:00 on the clock, grids grow from 2×2 to 5×5, power-ups between grids.
My Records on the main menu.

releases.title: The new T7P Arcade
items: Loading screen, main menu, Pick Your Icon, Settings and About.
Works offline and installs to your home screen.
